import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a boxplot to visualize the distribution of transaction amounts
# split by whether the transaction was fraudulent or not
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='is_fraud', palette='Set2')

plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount', fontsize=12)

# Add legend
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right')

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a boxplot to visualize the distribution of transaction amounts
# split by whether the transaction was fraudulent or not
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='is_fraud', palette='Set2')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Transaction Amounts by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount', fontsize=12)

# Add legend
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right')

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
